outcome: compliance rate for second newborn screening
cohort: The study included 104 preterm very low birth weight (VLBW) infants, defined as weighing less than 1,500 g.
finding: High rates of hypothyroidism (16.3%) and late TSH rise (4.8%) were detected, with hypothyroid patients having significantly lower birth weight and longer hospital stays.
birth_weight: less than 1,500 g (mean for late TSH rise group: 851 g; mean for early TSH rise group: 1,191 g)
